description: This file implements the security signing functionality for the ConfUi component, including methods for sending and receiving signed messages over file descriptors, handling errors, and managing message payloads.

classes.name: ConfUiSignerImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for signing messages, providing methods to send and receive signed messages over file descriptors.

classes.name: ConfUiSignSender
classes.description: Class responsible for sending signed messages.

classes.name: ConfUiSignRequester
classes.description: Class responsible for requesting signed messages.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a signed message with a specified error code and payload over a file descriptor.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Receives a signed message from a file descriptor, returning an optional message.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Receives a signed message via the ConfUiSignSender class.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a signed message with an error code and payload via the ConfUiSignSender class.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Requests a signed message by sending a message payload via the ConfUiSignRequester class.
